smtp.description: Configure a campaign sender. Office owns campaign content and adds its compliance footer; SMTP provides the reviewed delivery route.
smtp.checkNotice: The connection check validates SMTP authentication and TLS with a NOOP. It does not send email or confirm that the From alias can deliver or that a recipient received a message.
smtp.mailAccountsRequired: Connect a mail account before adding SMTP settings.
smtp.loadFailed: Could not load SMTP connections. Try again.
smtp.empty: No SMTP connections have been configured.
smtp.lastCheckFailed: The last connection check failed. Review the settings and try again.
smtp.requestFailed: The request failed. Review the SMTP settings and try again.
smtp.formDescription: The password is write-only and encrypted on the server. It is cleared when this form closes.
smtp.senderConfirmationRequired: Confirm that this From address is registered to the selected mail account.
smtp.customHeadersInvalid: Custom headers must be valid JSON with only the allowed header names and single-line string values.
smtp.name: Connection name
smtp.customHeadersHint: Allowed: X-Auto-Response-Suppress and X-Importance. Office adds campaign correlation and recipient-specific unsubscribe headers itself.
smtp.senderConfirmed: This From address is registered to the selected mail account.
smtp.disableDescription: {name} will stop being available for campaign delivery.

campaigns.title: Zoho Campaigns · Marketing
campaigns.description: Connect Zoho Campaigns and set up a verified marketing sender. Office owns campaign content and sends approved exports through the free Campaigns API.
campaigns.setupDescription: A registered Client ID and Client Secret are required. Office will not open a broken Zoho sign-in link while these are missing.
campaigns.callbackHint: Register this exact address in the Zoho API Console. Host, port and path must all match.
campaigns.instructions: How to configure Zoho Campaigns OAuth
campaigns.step1: In the US API Console, create a Server-based Application.
campaigns.step2: Set your application homepage and copy the authorized redirect URI above exactly.
campaigns.step3: Set ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_ID and ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_SECRET in the private server environment. Set ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_REDIRECT_URI to the address above.
campaigns.step4: Load that environment when starting the API, restart it, then connect and approve the Campaigns permissions in Zoho.
campaigns.securityHint: Keep Client Secret and refresh tokens out of chat and Git. Tokens are exchanged and encrypted only on the server.
campaigns.capabilities: Office writes the campaign HTML and recipient values. Free Campaigns can create and send the approved draft; scheduling and webhooks are unavailable. The paid Zoho Email API add-on is not required.
campaigns.writeScopeTitle: Some existing connections need updated access
campaigns.writeScopeNotice: Zoho Campaigns added a permission for creating campaign drafts. If you connected this account before the new permission, reconnect once to grant it. Office owns the HTML; the paid Zoho Email API add-on is not required.
campaigns.requestFailed: The operation failed. Check the server OAuth configuration, exact redirect URI and account permissions; reconnect if authorization was revoked.
campaigns.recentCampaignsHint: Read-only metadata from campaigns in this account. This check does not add contacts or send email.
campaigns.recentCampaignsFailed: Could not load recent campaigns. Check the connection and try again.
campaigns.noRecentCampaigns: No campaigns were found in this Zoho account.
campaigns.authorizeDescription: Open Zoho and approve the Campaigns permissions, including draft creation and sending. This link is temporary and shown only once.
campaigns.listsHint: Read-only connection check. No contact is subscribed and no email is sent.
campaigns.noLists: Connection verified. No mailing lists have been created yet.
campaigns.disconnectHint: Office stops using this connection and removes its locally stored tokens. Contacts and campaigns in Zoho are retained. You can revoke the app grant in Zoho Accounts separately.

channelSetup.title: Marketing delivery channel
channelSetup.description: Register a sender already verified in Zoho, create a disabled channel, then submit evidence for human policy review and enable it separately.
channelSetup.connectMailFirst: Connect a Zoho Mail account before registering a campaign sender.
channelSetup.connectCampaignsFirst: Connect an active Zoho Campaigns account before creating a marketing channel.
channelSetup.name: Channel name
channelSetup.noVerifiedSender: No verified sender is registered for this account yet.
channelSetup.createNotice: New channels start disabled and unverified. Review evidence and enable the channel in separate steps.
channelSetup.createFailed: Could not create the marketing channel.
channelSetup.reviewFailed: Could not save the policy review.
channelSetup.enableFailed: Could not enable the channel. Reload its latest state and try again.
channelSetup.senderNeedsVerification: Choose its mail account to confirm sender status
channelSetup.reviewDescription: Record the human policy review for {name}. The channel stays disabled until you enable it separately.
channelSetup.confirmVerified: I reviewed this evidence and confirmed that this verified sender may be used for marketing.
channelSetup.reviewDefaultNote: Human admin reviewed sender and marketing policy evidence.
channelSetup.registerSenderTitle: Register a sender already verified in Zoho
channelSetup.registerSenderDescription: Office records the evidence you provide. It does not contact Zoho or send a verification email.
channelSetup.senderConfirmed: I have already verified this sender in Zoho Campaigns and the evidence URL supports that claim.
